components.name: Pad Button
components.css: .ds-btn-pad { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-pad, #e6b24a); color: var(--color-board, #25154d); padding: 12px 20px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgb(230 178 74 / .75); transition: background-color .2s, transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-pad:hover { background: var(--color-pad-strong, #f2c566); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-pad:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6b24a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Board Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid #c9bfe8; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #f3efff; padding: 12px 20px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color .2s, border-color .2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #33206a; border-color: #f3efff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6b24a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Short choices, output and screen width.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #8c83a3; border-radius: 6px; background: #f5f3fa; font: 14px system-ui; } .ds-seg span { padding: 6px 10px; text-align: center; border-radius: 4px; color: #534c63; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: #25154d; color: #f3efff; }

components.name: Add-on Switch
components.description: Toggles an add-on on or off.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: 1px solid #25154d; border-radius: 9999px; background: #25154d; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e6b24a; transform: translateX(20px); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked=false] { background: #f5f3fa; border-color: #8c83a3; } .ds-switch[aria-checked=false] span { background: #8c83a3; transform: none; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25154d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Find an option, e.g. clear">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #8c83a3; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #16121f; padding: 8px 12px; font: 14px system-ui; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #534c63; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25154d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: PASS Stamp
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-6deg); border: 2px solid #13744a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 6px; color: #13744a; font: 700 18px 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Every component is a part in a catalogue: it has a part number, a spec line, a pinout (its keyboard map), a test report, and an order code (the install command). The site borrows the two materials of electronics: the solder-mask board and the white datasheet. Purple board carries identity; white paper carries the work; gold contact pads mark what is live and what to press.
keyCharacteristics: Two materials: purple board for identity, white datasheet paper for work.
Gold pads for live, active and primary.
Condensed uppercase display type; plain sans for reading; mono only for part numbers, data and code.
Real, running components as the imagery.
Accessibility shown as a feature: keyboard maps, test reports, PASS stamps.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: A surface is either board or paper. Never mix them in a gradient or tint one toward the other.

rules.name: The Gold Means Live Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what is live, changed or clickable-primary. Decoration in gold dilutes it.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace only for part numbers, measurements, code and table data, never as a technical costume.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading. Part numbers sit beside or below the name, never above it.

rules.name: The Mounted Only Rule
rules.body: Only mounted parts, the bench frame and primary gold buttons cast shadows. Panels are bordered, not lifted.

dos: Do mount real, running components as the imagery; the component is the proof.
Do keep every option's one-line description visible under its control.
Do mark changed options (gold dot, "Changed", per-option Reset) and count them on their group tab.
Do switch every animation off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use gold on board or as a fill; for text on paper use purple or ink.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use monospace for anything that isn't a part number, data or code.
Don't set gold text on white paper (2:1 contrast).
Don't add grid-paper backgrounds outside measuring surfaces (the test bench is the one place).
Don't invent usage numbers, customers or benchmarks; the test report states only what the tests check.
